purpose: Generate final pins only after independent source reviews and central checks. Does not start a clock, freeze, release or dispatch. No sealed fixture/gold/rationale/full-findings file is read.
invocation: Prepare a new contents-free builder-inputs.json meeting this contract after final source checks. Do not use placeholders.
Compute its exact SHA256 yourself, then run: python3 build-protocol.py --inputs BUILDER_INPUTS_JSON --inputs-sha256 EXACT_SHA256 --output NEW_PROTOCOL_JSON
The output path must not exist. Review the generated protocol and pins before separate inventory/clock/freeze actions. No protocol is generated during tooling development.

input_ref_definition.rules: Exactly these two fields. SHA256 is lowercase64hex and must match current existing public bytes. Missing, changed, all-zero or repeated-character pins reject. Paths inside sealed_directory or named private fixture/gold/findings/author files reject before read.

required_input_fields.sealed_directory: Absolute private sealed directory path; never opened by builder.
required_input_fields.baseline_runtime_root: Actual exact47-module isolated dd60f1c baseline root.
required_input_fields.runtime_receipt: Pinned JSON ref with status final_source_candidate and exact runtime_files map. Map equals every current codex_mem/*.py (not a fixed47assumption).
required_input_fields.tests_binding: Pinned normalized binding JSON; described below.
required_input_fields.spec_binding: Pinned normalized binding JSON; described below.
required_input_fields.standards_binding: Pinned normalized binding JSON; described below.
required_input_fields.harness_files: Nonempty relative repo path→actual SHA256 map. Must cover global helper plus every PUBLIC path declared by builder, including builder/tests/this contract; optional additional evidence pins are verified too.
required_input_fields.author_manifest: Pinned contents-free author manifest copy only. files pins include final fixture/gold/bothsealedreviewfiles; counts include96questions and reviewed required-fact total.
required_input_fields.sealed_pins: Pinned contents-free sealed files manifest copy only; basename→SHA256. Does not cause reading those sealed files.
required_input_fields.review_metadata: Pinned public copy of strict sealed-semantic-review-metadata schema object; bytes match sealed metadata pin. Accepted/zero unresolved/complete coverage and exact contracts required.
required_input_fields.review_readiness: Pinned parent metadata-only readiness receipt; accepted metadata-not-trial-readiness status, matching metadata/pins/author-manifest SHA and zero unresolved review findings.
required_input_fields.historical_spend: Pinned contents-free historical native-spend receipt. No amount is inferred or charged to new trial.

repeats.regeneration: Explicit one author-reported history identifier. Parent-reported R17 identifier is F01.
repeats.reader: Explicit distinct author-reported history identifier. Parent-reported R17 identifier is F02.
repeats.source: Parent received IDs F01..F16 as contents-free author metadata. Builder cannot prove ID membership without opening fixture; parent must confirm against author ID-only attestation.

normalized_binding.runtime_files: Exact same final runtime map as runtime_receipt and current files.
normalized_binding.original: Pinned existing original machine-verdict JSON. Not an invented substitute for the original review/test artifact. Bind both layers, never infer clear from normalized binding alone.

required_fields.evidence_files: nonempty public raw-log/test-evidence path→SHA map; all bytes verified

original_tests_receipt.limits: Machine verdicts and logs remain evidence, not mathematical proof tests exercise all intended behavior.

required_fields.source_manifest: Pinned original reviewed manifest JSON with runtime_files exactly equal current candidate modules

original_source_review_receipt.limits: Root ensures these are the actual independent review outputs and manifest, not self-certified replacements. Both Spec and Standards required.

preserved_public_controls: Six previously disclosed cases and known grouped-six judge packet remain unchanged, pinned to historical public corpus/library bytes. Their success would be a regression gate, not independent quality evidence.
output_and_limits: Actual48orotherfinal module count comes from exact filesystem inventory; missing/extra/changed modules or stale review/test bindings reject. All observed pins and runtime inventories are rechecked before return. A later independent freeze still must verify current bytes.

Strict semantic-review metadata/schema/full-findings hash bindings enter independent_review_contract. Full findings stay private and are never parsed by this builder. Driver later validates sealed bytes/counts after permitted release.
Additional sealed receipt pins can be frozen with unchanged helper. Accepted metadata remains an attestation, not proof of truth, independence or scenario difficulty.
This builder does not call the helper, import the runtime, make native calls, start or reset a clock, create run.json/freeze.json, repair old inputs, or mark the trial ready.
The pure build_protocol unit seam accepts a toy guide only for synthetic tests. CLI pins exact historical R16 public protocol SHA; no configurable alternative guide.

No real protocol exists until root supplies final successful source/test/review bindings and explicitly invokes generation. Preserve the earlier6pass1missing-protocol scaffold error; do not rerun public offline suite before then.
